final_text:
**Total overdue AP in USMF as of 2026‑08‑11: $35,934,094.70**

How I got it:
- Queried `VendorTransactions` (posted AP subledger) filtered to `dataareaid='USMF'`, `closed=0` (still open), `due_date < 2026-08-11`.
- 1,422 open invoices matched — and as it turns out, **every** open invoice at USMF is past due (the latest due date among open items is 2026‑04‑15, well before today), so "open AP" and "overdue AP" are the same set here.
- 1,421 of those lines are USD; one (EUR 294.72, invoice FAB‑7781) needed FX conversion — used the EUR→USD rate on file (1.0842) → $319.54.
- Sum: $35,933,775.16 (USD lines) + $319.54 (converted EUR line) = **$35,934,094.70**.
- Sanity-checked: no negative/credit balances in the open set, no separate AP aging snapshot exists to cross-check against (only an AR aging snapshot entity exists), so the live subledger sum is authoritative.

Submitted `total_overdue_ap: 35934094.70` and `as_of_date: 2026-08-11`.
